description: Replaces the WiFi SSID and password. Both fields are required. Channel, TX power, and security protocol are not configurable.

pathParameters.name: workspaceID
pathParameters.description: Workspace UUID. Obtain from API call: GET /v1/mobility/workspaces

pathParameters.name: deviceID
pathParameters.description: Device UUID. Obtain from API call: GET /v1/mobility/workspaces/{workspaceID}/devices

remote.python:
import http.client
import json


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.ui.com")
payload = json.dumps({
  "ssid": "MyNetwork",
  "password": "securepass123"
})
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
conn.request("PUT", "/v1/mobility/workspaces/{workspaceID}/devices/{deviceID}/wireless", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
